name: Kurzen's Compound
summary: Stormwind's expedition has turned against the kingdom at Kurzen's Compound in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Colonel Kurzen's madness has made it a camp of rogue soldiers and wild beasts.

sections.title: Heart of Darkness
sections.body: Colonel Kurzen's expedition came to Stranglethorn on Stormwind's orders. Then the colonel's madness changed its course, and the garrison broke from the kingdom to follow him. Now the compound is a mercenary stronghold. Its lumber mill and stables hold captured Stranglethorn panthers and tigers trained for war. In the caves called the Stockpile, Kurzen's men keep their plundered supplies.

sections.title: A Divided Regiment
sections.body: Some of Kurzen's original soldiers refused to follow him into savagery. When madness took hold of the colonel, they mutinied and fled west. There they founded the Rebel Camp. A bitter, bloody feud followed beneath the jungle canopy. Kurzen and his loyal men hunt the deserters, and treat every outsider who enters their domain as an enemy.

faq.answer: Rogue remnants of Kurzen's Expedition occupy the compound. The human soldiers, jungle fighters, and mercenaries follow Colonel Kurzen and his lieutenants instead of Stormwind's laws.

faq.q: Why are the humans here hostile?
faq.answer: Colonel Kurzen went mad in the jungle and abandoned his allegiance to the Alliance. He and his men see every trespasser as a mortal threat, from Alliance forces to the deserters at the nearby Rebel Camp.

faq.q: What is the cave in the back of the camp?
faq.answer: The caves behind the compound are called the Stockpile. Kurzen's men use them as a fortified depot for weapons, provisions, and contraband, keeping supplies from jungle scavengers and rebel raids.

faq.q: Why are there caged tigers and panthers here?
faq.answer: Kurzen's fighters capture native Stranglethorn tigers and panthers and keep them near the stables. They train the predators as Kurzen War Panthers and War Tigers to defend the compound and patrol the surrounding jungle.

angles.text: Stormwind sent Kurzen's expedition under the Alliance banner. The outpost's fall into madness is a shameful scandal, and nearby rebels seek to set things right.
The compound shows how its fighters try to tame wild Stranglethorn panthers and tigers as beasts of war.
